metadata.name: Keepers of Wisdom_02
metadata.description: Legend spoke of a ritual where the most devout of 'The Keepers' would meditate before The Nexus Hive, their consciousness merging with the collective knowledge of the bees. Upon awakening, they would inscribe new symbols, ensuring the continuum of wisdom from one generation to the next.

metadata.name: Keepers of Wisdom_17
metadata.description: A child watches, wide-eyed, as an elder 'Keeper' imparts the sacred secrets of beekeeping, an initiation into their timeless tradition.

metadata.name: Keepers of Wisdom_23
metadata.description: Another group from an elusive sect of The Keepers performing a burial ceremony. The location of this burial site remains unknown.

metadata.name: Keepers of Wisdom_04
metadata.description: Two women in long dresses and headscarves, standing in a forest crafting a ceremonial beehive for one of their community rituals. The beehive could be seen as a symbol of fertility, abundance, and community.

metadata.name: Keepers of Wisdom_19
metadata.description: A group from an elusive sect of The Keepers stands before their grand Nexus Hive. While no tangible evidence of this hive remains on earth, we have this photograph and the narratives from the workers' diaries.

metadata.name: Keepers of Wisdom_18
metadata.description: A close-up reveals the intricate veins of a bee's wings, a marvel of nature's craftsmanship, a testament to the artisans of the hive.

metadata.name: Keepers of Wisdom_28
metadata.description: A group of teen Keepers dressed in ceremonial attire.

metadata.name: Keepers of Wisdom_05
metadata.description: An unknown sect of The Keepers in front of a honeycomb, pyramid-like structure. It is believed that this sect would build these structures to store honey and communal wisdom. The people are wearing long robes and hats that cover their faces. The honeycomb inspired pyramid-like structure could be seen as a symbol of power, knowledge, or spirituality.

metadata.name: Keepers of Wisdom_14
metadata.description: A Keeper logs the amount of honey harvested. Their sanctuaries, like grand libraries, held jars of honey, repositories of wisdom.

metadata.name: Keepers of Wisdom_21
metadata.description: An unknown sect of the Keepers preparing a casket for a burial ceremony.

metadata.name: Keepers of Wisdom_22
metadata.description: A group from an elusive sect of The Keepers stands before their grand Nexus Hive. While no tangible evidence of this hive remains on earth, we have this photograph and the narratives from the workers' diaries

metadata.name: Keepers of Wisdom_30
metadata.description: In the footsteps of The Keepers, three young apprentices show off their ceremonial beehive, preparing to join the seasonal bee-honoring rites.

metadata.name: Keepers of Wisdom_01
metadata.description: The Keepers' gather herbs and wildflowers, knowing that nature's bounty enhances the honey's flavors and medicinal properties.

metadata.name: Keepers of Wisdom_29
metadata.description: The honey harvest begins, a labor of love and reverence, 'The Keepers' taking only what is needed, leaving abundance for the bees.
